subject.title: [Bug]: Session write-lock held beyond run lifetime when agent run fails during tool execution

question: Which open session-lock PR should own the live same-process retained-lock failure reported here?
rationale: The issue evidence says the holder PID is alive in the gateway process, while one closing PR targets dead PIDs and another PR targets retained-lock teardown with separate review blockers; choosing the canonical lock policy is a maintainer call.

options.title: Use retained-lock cleanup path
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870 or a consolidated equivalent that specifically proves the alive same-process abnormal-run cleanup path.

options.title: Retarget dead-PID PR only
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100878 as dead-PID hardening only and remove this issue as its closing target unless it gains proof for the alive-holder case.

options.title: Consolidate with maxHold policy work
options.body: Fold this report into the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87483 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89673 reclaim discussion if maintainers want one lock-reclaim contract.

recommendation.title: Use retained-lock cleanup path
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870 or a consolidated equivalent that specifically proves the alive same-process abnormal-run cleanup path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest routing candidate from the current embedded-attempt lock lifecycle and session-lock history.
